final_text:
Done. Files in `.`:

- `index.html` — import map (three 0.170.0 from jsDelivr, exactly as specified), HTML overlay (score, lives, bricks, status, hint, fps), relative `./styles.css` and `./main.js`.
- `styles.css` — HUD styling.
- `main.js` — canvas, rAF loop, fps readout, WebGL failure fallback text.
- `js/config.js` — field/grid/paddle/ball/light/camera constants.
- `js/entities.js` — meshes: brick boxes, walls, floor, box paddle, sphere ball, ball trail.
- `js/collision.js` — swept, sub-stepped ball step; brick/wall reflections, paddle bounce angle from hit offset, lost-ball past the paddle.
- `js/input.js` — arrow/A-D held keys + Space (start/serve/restart).
- `js/ui.js` — overlay updates.
- `js/game.js` — perspective camera looking down at the field at an angle (follows the ball), one directional light + ambient, bloom, shadows, state machine (start / play / ball lost / game over / win).
- `README.md` — what it is, controls, how it works.

Verification (headless Chromium, SwiftShader, ~16-18 fps): no console errors, no page errors, no failed requests. The overlay reacts to input — e.g. `Space,wait:12000` → `SCORE 7 / BRICKS 47 / Break them all`; long runs reach `Game over` (3 lives lost) and, with a small grid, `You win — score N`; paddle position responds to `A`/`ArrowRight`/`ArrowLeft` (verified with a temporary debug readout in a scratch copy), and paddle hits bounce the ball back into the bricks.
